title: Incident
description: Emitted by the CNC 411 Blue Team via POST /api/v1/incidents. Consumed by the CNC 419 GRC platform to recalculate residual risk and drive the After-Action Review. Carries the containment KPIs (MTTD/MTTC/MTTR).

exercise_run_id.description: Same correlation id as the Red Team finding it responds to.

target_asset.description: asset_id the incident was raised on (joins back to the GRC AssetProfile).

mttd_sec.description: Mean Time To Detect: seconds from first malicious telemetry to alert.

mttc_sec.description: Mean Time To Contain: seconds from alert to containment action taken.

mttr_sec.description: Mean Time To Recover/Remediate: seconds from detection to restored-safe state.

containment_action.description: Vendor-neutral containment verb that was executed (or proposed for human approval).

residual_status.description: State of the threat after response.

linked_finding_id.description: Optional back-reference to the Red Team finding_id this incident correlated to.

explanation.description: Required XAI payload. A bare confidence score is NOT an acceptable substitute for an evidence-backed explanation.
